from pathlib import Path

def patch(path, pairs):
    p = Path(path)
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    for old, new in pairs:
        n = text.count(old)
        assert n == 1, (path, n, old[:70])
        text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
